Alternative analysis pipeline:
More LMs/GLMs, followed by AIC to find the right distribution, followed by ANOVA and Dunnett's test

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Functions defined here
# copied from https://rdrr.io/bioc/imageHTS/man/zprime.html

zprime = function(a, b, method=c('mahalanobis', 'robust', 'fixsd', 'original')) {
    method = match.arg(method)
    
    if (method=='mahalanobis') {
        if (is.null(dim(a))) a = matrix(a, ncol=1)
        if (is.null(dim(b))) b = matrix(b, ncol=1)
        mua = apply(a, 2, mean)
        mub = apply(b, 2, mean)
        dm = try(mahalanobis(mua, mub, cov(a) + cov(b)))
        if (class(dm)=='try-error') NA
        else 1-3/sqrt(dm)
    }
    else {
        if (method=='robust') 1-3*(mad(a)+mad(b))/abs(median(a)-median(b))
        else if (method=='fixsd') 1-3*sqrt(var(a)+var(b))/abs(mean(a)-mean(b))
        else 1-3*(sd(a)+sd(b))/abs(mean(a)-mean(b))
    }
}


investigate_raw_maps <- function(to_plot, request){
    request <- eval(request)
    request <- quo_name(enquo(request))
    
    raw_map(data = to_plot[[request]], 
            well = to_plot$WellName, 
            plate = 96) + labs(title = request)
}
```

```{r countdata}
library(MASS)      # glm.nb
library(stats)     # glm
library(ggplot2)
library(multcomp)  # glht / Dunnett
library(gridExtra) # optional; remove if not installed

fit_distribution_and_diagnostics <- function(df, yname, control_level="AAVS1") {
  df <- df
  df$knockdown <- relevel(factor(df$knockdown), ref = control_level)
  df$plate <- factor(df$plate)
  df$row   <- factor(df$row)
  df$col   <- factor(df$col)

  form <- as.formula(paste0(yname, " ~ knockdown + plate + row + col"))

  # Poisson
  fit_pois <- glm(form, data=df, family=poisson())

  # Negative binomial
  fit_nb <- glm.nb(form, data=df)

  aic_tbl <- data.frame(
    model = c("Poisson", "NegBin"),
    AIC   = c(AIC(fit_pois), AIC(fit_nb))
  )
  aic_tbl <- aic_tbl[order(aic_tbl$AIC), ]

  best_fit <- if (aic_tbl$model[1] == "Poisson") fit_pois else fit_nb
  best_name <- aic_tbl$model[1]

  list(
    feature = yname,
    fits = list(Poisson = fit_pois, NegBin = fit_nb),
    aic = aic_tbl,
    best_fit = best_fit,
    best_name = best_name
  )
}


plot_glm_diagnostics <- function(fit, title="") {
  rp <- residuals(fit, type="pearson")
  fv <- fitted(fit)

  op <- par(mfrow=c(2,2))
  plot(fv, rp, xlab="Fitted", ylab="Pearson residuals",
       main=paste0("Residuals vs fitted: ", title))
  abline(h=0, col="red")

  qqnorm(rp, main=paste0("QQ of Pearson residuals: ", title))
  qqline(rp, col="red")

  plot(fv, sqrt(abs(rp)), xlab="Fitted", ylab="sqrt(|Pearson residuals|)",
       main=paste0("Scale check: ", title))

  plot(cooks.distance(fit), type="h",
       main=paste0("Cook's distance: ", title),
       ylab="Cook's D")
  par(op)
}
```

```{r bigcheck}


library(glmmTMB)
library(MASS)
library(DHARMa)

#-----------------------------
# User settings
#-----------------------------
df <- spot_count_df_extended  # <-- change if needed
y  <- "spot_count"
control_level <- "AAVS1"

# Ensure types
df$knockdown <- relevel(factor(df$knockdown), ref = control_level)
df$plate <- factor(df$plate)


# Quadrant blocks

# Make sure plate is character
df$plate <- as.character(df$plate)

# Extract numeric plate index from "P1_SIMA_V5.txt", "P10_SIMA_V5.txt", etc.
plate_num <- as.integer(sub("^P([0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", df$plate))

# Create layout blocks of 3 plates: (P1-P3)->1, (P4-P6)->2, ...
df$layout_block <- factor((plate_num - 1) %/% 3 + 1)


if (!("layout_block" %in% names(df))) df$layout_block <- factor(df$layout_block)

# If row and col are currently numeric-like strings:
df$row_num <- as.numeric(as.character(df$row))
df$col_num <- as.numeric(as.character(df$col))

# then optionally scale for stability:
df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$row_num))
df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$col_num))

# (If you already have scaled columns, adjust names accordingly.)
if (!("row_sc" %in% names(df))) df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(df$row_num)))
if (!("col_sc" %in% names(df))) df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(df$col_num)))

# Helper to safely fit models
fit_safe <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
    message("Model failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Helper to safely compute AIC
aic_safe <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA_real_)
  a <- tryCatch(AIC(model), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  as.numeric(a)
}

# Helper to DHARMa + p-values
dharma_safe <- function(model, n = 2000, plot = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(list(sim = NULL, p = c(KS = NA, Disp = NA, Out = NA)))
  sim <- simulateResiduals(model, n = n)
  if (plot) plot(sim)
  pKS   <- suppressMessages(testUniformity(sim)$p.value)
  pDisp <- suppressMessages(testDispersion(sim)$p.value)
  pOut  <- suppressMessages(testOutliers(sim)$p.value)
  list(sim = sim, p = c(KS = pKS, Disp = pDisp, Out = pOut))
}

#-----------------------------
# Candidate model ladder
#-----------------------------
models <- list(
  # Gaussian (lm) increasing complexity
  m1_lm_knockdown = function() {
    lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown")), data = df)
  },

  m2_lm_knock_plate = function() {
    lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate")), data = df)
  },

  m3_lm_knock_plate_space = function() {
    lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc")), data = df)
  },

  # NB GLM (MASS::glm.nb) - fixed effects only
  m4_glmnb_basic = function() {
    glm.nb(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc")), data = df)
  },

  m5_glmnb_quadratic = function() {
    glm.nb(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc +
                         I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2)")),
      data = df
    )
  },

  # NB GLMM (glmmTMB) - random plate intercept
  m6_glmm_nb_intercept = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc + (1|plate)")),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  m7_glmm_nb_intercept_quadratic = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc +
                         I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2) + (1|plate)")),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  # More complicated random slopes within plate (often helps “snaking”)
  m8_glmm_nb_random_slopes = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc + (1 + row_sc + col_sc | plate)")),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  m9_glmm_nb_random_slopes_quadratic = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(
        y,
        " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc +
          I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2) +
          (1 + row_sc + col_sc | plate)"
      )),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  # Optional: include layout_block fixed effect (only if layout_block is meaningful)
  m10_glmm_nb_layout_block = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(
        y,
        " ~ knockdown + layout_block + row_sc + col_sc + I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2) + (1|plate)"
      )),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  }
)

#-----------------------------
# Fit, AIC, DHARMa
#-----------------------------
run_models <- function(models, dharma_n = 2000, make_plots = TRUE) {
  out <- list()
  summary_rows <- list()

  for (nm in names(models)) {
    message("\n==== Fitting: ", nm, " ====")
    fit <- fit_safe(models[[nm]]())

    aic <- aic_safe(fit)

    dh <- dharma_safe(fit, n = dharma_n, plot = make_plots)

    summary_rows[[nm]] <- data.frame(
      model = nm,
      AIC = aic,
      KS_p = dh$p["KS"],
      Disp_p = dh$p["Disp"],
      Out_p = dh$p["Out"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    out[[nm]] <- list(fit = fit, dh = dh, AIC = aic)
  }

  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
  summary_df <- summary_df[order(summary_df$AIC), ]

  list(all = out, summary = summary_df)
}

# Run it (set make_plots=FALSE if you only want AIC/p-values)
res <- run_models(models, dharma_n = 2000, make_plots = TRUE)

# View ranking by AIC
res$summary


res_table <- res$summary

### Seems like the best one is m3, a gaussian model rip


model_name <- "m3_lm_knock_plate_space"  # pick one from names(res$all)

fit <- res$all[[model_name]]$fit

sim <- simulateResiduals(fit, n = 2000)
plot(sim)                # QQ-style & residual checks
testUniformity(sim)
testDispersion(sim)
testOutliers(sim)


par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plotResiduals(sim, form = ~ knockdown)
plotResiduals(sim, form = ~ plate)
plotResiduals(sim, form = ~ row_sc) # HMMM
plotResiduals(sim, form = ~ col_sc)

m1 <- lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc")), data = df)

m2 <- lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate +
           poly(row_sc, 2, raw=TRUE) +
           poly(col_sc, 2, raw=TRUE)")),
         data=df)

plotSimulatedResiduals(r2, residuals~df$row_sc)  # or use the usual DHARMa panels

plotResiduals(r2, form = ~ row_sc) # much better...
plotResiduals(r2, form = ~ col_sc)

df$plate <- factor(df$plate)
df$row <- factor(df$row)
df$col <- factor(df$col)



m3 <- lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + factor(plate) + factor(row) + factor(col) ")), data=df)

plotSimulatedResiduals(r3, residuals~df$row_sc)  # or use the usual DHARMa panels
```

```{r finalfits}






fit_full <- lm(spot_count ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc, data = df)
fit_red  <- lm(spot_count ~ plate + row_sc + col_sc, data = df)

anova(fit_red, fit_full)  # F-test for knockdown after adjustment


library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(fit_full, ~ knockdown)

contr <- contrast(
  emm,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "AAVS1",       # your control level
  adjust = "dunnett"
)

summary(contr, infer = TRUE)

dt_spot_count <- summary(contr, infer = TRUE)



# Get a data frame with estimate + CI + p-values
ds_emm <- summary(contr, infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  # emmeans often names columns like: contrast, estimate, SE, df, lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value
  rename(
    diff = estimate,
    lwr.ci = lower.CL,
    upr.ci = upper.CL,
    pval = p.value
  ) %>%
  # make sure we have a "contrast" column
  mutate(contrast = as.character(contrast))

# plotting

ds_emm_plot <- ds_emm %>%
  #extract group and control from "contrast" assuming it contains " - "
  mutate(
    group = str_split_fixed(contrast, "-", 2)[,1],
    control = str_split_fixed(contrast, "-", 2)[,2]
  ) %>%
  #order for plotting
  arrange(diff) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast)) %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(pval < 0.05 ~ "TRUE", TRUE ~ "FALSE"))

ggplot(ds_emm_plot, aes(x = diff, y = contrast)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lwr.ci, xmax = upr.ci), height = 0.25, color = "grey30") +
  geom_point(aes(color = pval < 0.05), size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "red")) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Difference vs ", control_level, " (diff)"),
    y = "",
    color = "Significant",
    title = "Dunnett (emmeans) estimates and 95% CI - Spot count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
```

```{r otherfeatures}
df$knockdown <- relevel(factor(df$knockdown), ref = control_level)
df$plate <- factor(df$plate)


# Quadrant blocks

# Make sure plate is character
df$plate <- as.character(df$plate)

# Extract numeric plate index from "P1_SIMA_V5.txt", "P10_SIMA_V5.txt", etc.
plate_num <- as.integer(sub("^P([0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", df$plate))

# Create layout blocks of 3 plates: (P1-P3)->1, (P4-P6)->2, ...
df$layout_block <- factor((plate_num - 1) %/% 3 + 1)


if (!("layout_block" %in% names(df))) df$layout_block <- factor(df$layout_block)

# If row and col are currently numeric-like strings:
df$row_num <- as.numeric(as.character(df$row))
df$col_num <- as.numeric(as.character(df$col))

# then optionally scale for stability:
df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$row_num))
df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$col_num))

# (If you already have scaled columns, adjust names accordingly.)
if (!("row_sc" %in% names(df))) df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(df$row_num)))
if (!("col_sc" %in% names(df))) df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(df$col_num)))

# Helper to safely fit models
fit_safe <- function(expr) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
    message("Model failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Helper to safely compute AIC
aic_safe <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(NA_real_)
  a <- tryCatch(AIC(model), error = function(e) NA_real_)
  as.numeric(a)
}

# Helper to DHARMa + p-values
dharma_safe <- function(model, n = 2000, plot = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(list(sim = NULL, p = c(KS = NA, Disp = NA, Out = NA)))
  sim <- simulateResiduals(model, n = n)
  if (plot) plot(sim)
  pKS   <- suppressMessages(testUniformity(sim)$p.value)
  pDisp <- suppressMessages(testDispersion(sim)$p.value)
  pOut  <- suppressMessages(testOutliers(sim)$p.value)
  list(sim = sim, p = c(KS = pKS, Disp = pDisp, Out = pOut))
}

#-----------------------------
# Candidate model ladder
#-----------------------------
models <- list(
  # Gaussian (lm) increasing complexity
  m1_lm_knockdown = function() {
    lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown")), data = df)
  },

  m2_lm_knock_plate = function() {
    lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate")), data = df)
  },

  m3_lm_knock_plate_space = function() {
    lm(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc")), data = df)
  },

  # NB GLM (MASS::glm.nb) - fixed effects only
  m4_glmnb_basic = function() {
    glm.nb(as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc")), data = df)
  },

  m5_glmnb_quadratic = function() {
    glm.nb(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + plate + row_sc + col_sc +
                         I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2)")),
      data = df
    )
  },

  # NB GLMM (glmmTMB) - random plate intercept
  m6_glmm_nb_intercept = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc + (1|plate)")),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  m7_glmm_nb_intercept_quadratic = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc +
                         I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2) + (1|plate)")),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  # More complicated random slopes within plate (often helps “snaking”)
  m8_glmm_nb_random_slopes = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(y, " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc + (1 + row_sc + col_sc | plate)")),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  m9_glmm_nb_random_slopes_quadratic = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(
        y,
        " ~ knockdown + row_sc + col_sc +
          I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2) +
          (1 + row_sc + col_sc | plate)"
      )),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  },

  # Optional: include layout_block fixed effect (only if layout_block is meaningful)
  m10_glmm_nb_layout_block = function() {
    glmmTMB(
      as.formula(paste0(
        y,
        " ~ knockdown + layout_block + row_sc + col_sc + I(row_sc^2) + I(col_sc^2) + (1|plate)"
      )),
      data = df,
      family = nbinom2()
    )
  }
)

#-----------------------------
# Fit, AIC, DHARMa
#-----------------------------
run_models <- function(models, dharma_n = 2000, make_plots = TRUE) {
  out <- list()
  summary_rows <- list()

  for (nm in names(models)) {
    message("\n==== Fitting: ", nm, " ====")
    fit <- fit_safe(models[[nm]]())

    aic <- aic_safe(fit)

    dh <- dharma_safe(fit, n = dharma_n, plot = make_plots)

    summary_rows[[nm]] <- data.frame(
      model = nm,
      AIC = aic,
      KS_p = dh$p["KS"],
      Disp_p = dh$p["Disp"],
      Out_p = dh$p["Out"],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    out[[nm]] <- list(fit = fit, dh = dh, AIC = aic)
  }

  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
  summary_df <- summary_df[order(summary_df$AIC), ]

  list(all = out, summary = summary_df)
}
```

```{r chathelp}
# =========================================================
# 1) Packages
# =========================================================
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(glmmTMB)
library(mgcv)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)

# =========================================================
# 2) Data setup
#    Replace the response column below if needed
# =========================================================
control_level <- "AAVS1"

df <- tibble(
  spot_area = final_plate_list$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well`,
  knockdown = final_plate_list$Gene,
  plate     = final_plate_list$plate,
  row       = final_plate_list$Row,
  col       = final_plate_list$Col
) %>%
  filter(knockdown != "Empty") %>%
  mutate(
    spot_area = as.numeric(spot_area),
    knockdown = factor(knockdown),
    plate     = factor(plate)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(spot_area),
    !is.na(knockdown),
    !is.na(plate),
    !is.na(row),
    !is.na(col)
  )

df$knockdown <- relevel(df$knockdown, ref = control_level)

# Row / column as numeric
row_chr <- as.character(df$row)
row_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row_chr))
if (all(is.na(row_num))) {
  row_num <- match(row_chr, sort(unique(row_chr)))
}
df$row_num <- row_num
df$col_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df$col)))

# Scaled versions
df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$row_num))
df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$col_num))

# Optional layout blocks, if plate names contain P1, P2, ...
plate_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^P([0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", as.character(df$plate))))
if (all(!is.na(plate_num))) {
  df$layout_block <- factor((plate_num - 1L) %/% 3L + 1L)
} else {
  df$layout_block <- factor(df$plate)
}

# Positive-response check
positive_response <- all(df$spot_area > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Quick sanity checks
summary(df$spot_area)
table(df$plate) %>% head()

hist(df$spot_area, breaks = 40, main = "Spot area", xlab = "spot_area")


# =========================================================
# 3) Helpers
# =========================================================
fit_safe <- function(fun) {
  tryCatch(
    fun(),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Model failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
}

aic_safe <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(as.numeric(AIC(fit)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

bic_safe <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(as.numeric(BIC(fit)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

logLik_safe <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(as.numeric(logLik(fit)), error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

converged_safe <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(FALSE)

  if (inherits(fit, "glmmTMB")) {
    return(isTRUE(fit$sdr$pdHess))
  }

  if (inherits(fit, "gam")) {
    return(isTRUE(fit$converged))
  }

  TRUE
}

dharma_safe <- function(fit, n = 1000, plot = FALSE) {
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(list(sim = NULL, p = c(KS = NA_real_, Disp = NA_real_, Out = NA_real_)))
  }

  sim <- tryCatch(
    simulateResiduals(fit, n = n),
    error = function(e) {
      message("DHARMa failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(sim)) {
    return(list(sim = NULL, p = c(KS = NA_real_, Disp = NA_real_, Out = NA_real_)))
  }

  if (plot) plot(sim)

  pvals <- c(
    KS   = tryCatch(testUniformity(sim)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    Disp = tryCatch(testDispersion(sim)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    Out  = tryCatch(testOutliers(sim)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  )

  list(sim = sim, p = pvals)
}

run_models <- function(model_specs, data, dharma_n = 1000, make_plots = FALSE) {
  results <- list()
  rows <- list()

  for (nm in names(model_specs)) {
    message("\n==== Fitting ", nm, " ====")

    fit <- fit_safe(function() model_specs[[nm]]$fit(data))
    dh  <- dharma_safe(fit, n = dharma_n, plot = make_plots)

    results[[nm]] <- list(
      fit = fit,
      dh  = dh
    )

    rows[[nm]] <- tibble(
      model        = nm,
      scale_group  = model_specs[[nm]]$scale_group,
      converged    = converged_safe(fit),
      AIC          = aic_safe(fit),
      BIC          = bic_safe(fit),
      logLik       = logLik_safe(fit),
      KS_p         = dh$p["KS"],
      Disp_p       = dh$p["Disp"],
      Out_p        = dh$p["Out"],
      dharma_fail_n = sum(dh$p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }

  summary_df <- bind_rows(rows) %>%
    arrange(scale_group, dharma_fail_n, AIC)

  list(results = results, summary = summary_df)
}

# =========================================================
# 4) Candidate models
#
# NOTE:
# - Compare AIC within the same `scale_group`
# - Do NOT compare raw-scale AIC to log-scale AIC directly
# =========================================================
model_specs <- list(

  # -------------------------
  # RAW-SCALE GAUSSIAN
  # -------------------------
  lm_raw_basic = list(
    scale_group = "raw",
    fit = function(data) {
      lm(spot_area ~ knockdown, data = data)
    }
  ),

  lm_raw_plate = list(
    scale_group = "raw",
    fit = function(data) {
      lm(spot_area ~ knockdown + plate, data = data)
    }
  ),

  lm_raw_polypos = list(
    scale_group = "raw",
    fit = function(data) {
      lm(
        spot_area ~ knockdown + plate +
          poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE),
        data = data
      )
    }
  ),

  gauss_glmm_re_plate = list(
    scale_group = "raw",
    fit = function(data) {
      glmmTMB(
        spot_area ~ knockdown +
          poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          (1 | plate),
        family = gaussian(),
        data = data
      )
    }
  ),

  gauss_glmm_het_plate = list(
    scale_group = "raw",
    fit = function(data) {
      glmmTMB(
        spot_area ~ knockdown +
          poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          (1 | plate),
        family = gaussian(),
        dispformula = ~ plate,
        data = data
      )
    }
  ),

  gam_raw_2d = list(
    scale_group = "raw",
    fit = function(data) {
      gam(
        spot_area ~ knockdown +
          s(plate, bs = "re") +
          te(row_num, col_num, k = c(4, 5)),
        data = data,
        method = "REML"
      )
    }
  )
)

if (positive_response) {
  model_specs <- c(model_specs, list(

    # -------------------------
    # LOG-SCALE GAUSSIAN
    # -------------------------
    lm_log_polypos = list(
      scale_group = "log",
      fit = function(data) {
        lm(
          log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE),
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    log_gauss_glmm_re_plate = list(
      scale_group = "log",
      fit = function(data) {
        glmmTMB(
          log(spot_area) ~ knockdown +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            (1 | plate),
          family = gaussian(),
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    gam_log_2d = list(
      scale_group = "log",
      fit = function(data) {
        gam(
          log(spot_area) ~ knockdown +
            s(plate, bs = "re") +
            te(row_num, col_num, k = c(4, 5)),
          data = data,
          method = "REML"
        )
      }
    ),

    # -------------------------
    # POSITIVE RAW-SCALE FAMILIES
    # -------------------------
    gamma_glm_polypos = list(
      scale_group = "raw",
      fit = function(data) {
        glm(
          spot_area ~ knockdown + plate +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE),
          family = Gamma(link = "log"),
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    gamma_glmm_re_plate = list(
      scale_group = "raw",
      fit = function(data) {
        glmmTMB(
          spot_area ~ knockdown +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            (1 | plate),
          family = Gamma(link = "log"),
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    gamma_glmm_het_plate = list(
      scale_group = "raw",
      fit = function(data) {
        glmmTMB(
          spot_area ~ knockdown +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            (1 | plate),
          family = Gamma(link = "log"),
          dispformula = ~ plate,
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    gamma_glmm_het_layout = list(
      scale_group = "raw",
      fit = function(data) {
        glmmTMB(
          spot_area ~ knockdown + layout_block +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            (1 | plate),
          family = Gamma(link = "log"),
          dispformula = ~ layout_block,
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    lognormal_glmm_re_plate = list(
      scale_group = "raw",
      fit = function(data) {
        glmmTMB(
          spot_area ~ knockdown +
            poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
            (1 | plate),
          family = lognormal(),
          data = data
        )
      }
    ),

    gam_gamma_2d = list(
      scale_group = "raw",
      fit = function(data) {
        gam(
          spot_area ~ knockdown +
            s(plate, bs = "re") +
            te(row_num, col_num, k = c(4, 5)),
          family = Gamma(link = "log"),
          data = data,
          method = "REML"
        )
      }
    )
  ))
} else {
  message("Non-positive values detected: skipping log/Gamma/lognormal models.")
}

# =========================================================
# 5) Fit everything
# =========================================================
res <- run_models(
  model_specs,
  data = df,
  dharma_n = 1000,
  make_plots = FALSE
)

res$summary

# =========================================================
# 6) Inspect best candidates
# =========================================================

# Best raw-scale model
best_raw_name <- res$summary %>%
  filter(scale_group == "raw", converged) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(model)

best_raw_name

best_raw_fit <- res$results[[best_raw_name]]$fit
best_raw_sim <- simulateResiduals(best_raw_fit, n = 2000)

plot(best_raw_sim)
testUniformity(best_raw_sim)
testDispersion(best_raw_sim)
testOutliers(best_raw_sim)

plotResiduals(best_raw_sim, form = df$row_num, main = "Residuals vs row")
plotResiduals(best_raw_sim, form = df$col_num, main = "Residuals vs col")
plotResiduals(best_raw_sim, form = df$plate,   main = "Residuals vs plate")

# Optional: best log-scale model
best_log_name <- res$summary %>%
  filter(scale_group == "log", converged) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(model)

best_log_name

if (length(best_log_name) == 1) {
  best_log_fit <- res$results[[best_log_name]]$fit
  best_log_sim <- simulateResiduals(best_log_fit, n = 2000)

  plot(best_log_sim)
  testUniformity(best_log_sim)
  testDispersion(best_log_sim)
  testOutliers(best_log_sim)
}

# =========================================================
# 7) Post-hoc comparisons vs control
#    Use a chosen final model
# =========================================================


# =========================================================
# 8) Optional advanced models
#    Only try these if residuals still show plate-specific
#    row/column structure after the simpler models
# =========================================================

# Gaussian mixed model with plate-specific row/col slopes
fit_gauss_slopes <- fit_safe(function() {
  glmmTMB(
    spot_area ~ knockdown +
      poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
      poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
      (1 + row_sc + col_sc | plate),
    family = gaussian(),
    data = df
  )
})

# Gamma mixed model with plate-specific row/col slopes
fit_gamma_slopes <- if (positive_response) fit_safe(function() {
  glmmTMB(
    spot_area ~ knockdown +
      poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
      poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
      (1 + row_sc + col_sc | plate),
    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
    data = df
  )
}) else NULL

# Check if these help
if (!is.null(fit_gauss_slopes)) {
  sim_gauss_slopes <- simulateResiduals(fit_gauss_slopes, n = 1000)
  plot(sim_gauss_slopes)
}

if (!is.null(fit_gamma_slopes)) {
  sim_gamma_slopes <- simulateResiduals(fit_gamma_slopes, n = 1000)
  plot(sim_gamma_slopes)
}

# =========================================================
# 9) Even more advanced models
#    Only try these if residuals still show plate-specific
#    row/column structure after the simpler models
# =========================================================
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    row_f = factor(row_num),
    col_f = factor(col_num)
  )


extra_specs <- list(
  log_gauss_glmm_het_plate = list(
    scale_group = "log",
    fit = function(data) {
      glmmTMB(
        log(spot_area) ~ knockdown +
          poly(row_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          poly(col_sc, 2, raw = TRUE) +
          (1 | plate),
        dispformula = ~ plate,
        family = gaussian(),
        data = data
      )
    }
  ),

  lm_log_rowcol_factor = list(
    scale_group = "log",
    fit = function(data) {
      lm(
        log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate + row_f + col_f,
        data = data
      )
    }
  ),

  log_gauss_glmm_plate_rowcol_re = list(
    scale_group = "log",
    fit = function(data) {
      glmmTMB(
        log(spot_area) ~ knockdown +
          (1 | plate) +
          (1 | plate:row_f) +

      )
    }
  ),

  log_gauss_glmm_plate_rowcol_re_het = list(

          (1 | plate) +
          (1 | plate:row_f) +

        data = data
      )
    }
  ),

  lm_log_poly_interaction = list(

      lm(
        log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate +

      )
    }

)

# Optional Student-t model if available
extra_specs$log_t_glmm_plate_rowcol_re <- list(
  scale_group = "log",

    glmmTMB(

)

res_extra <- run_models(extra_specs, data = df, dharma_n = 1000, make_plots = FALSE)
res_extra$summary

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    log_spot_area = log(spot_area),
```

```{r finalmodels}
# ==========================================
# DHARMa diagnostics for final model
# Assumes:
#   m_final   = fitted glmmTMB model
#   df_model  = data used to fit the model
# with columns:
#   log_spot_area, spot_area, knockdown, plate, row_num, col_num, row_f, col_f
# ==========================================


setwd("comp_bio/capture_c_adipocytes/main_screen/")

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(Hmisc)
library(bit64)
library(NbClust)
library(pheatmap)
library(plotly)
library(corrplot)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(heatmaply)
library(DHARMa)
library(glmmTMB)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)

quad_gene_key <- fread("Quad rearrangements.txt")

quad_gene_key$Well <- str_replace_all(quad_gene_key$Well,"0(?=\\d)", "")

plate_file_names <- list.files(pattern = "SIMA_V5", full.names = F)

plates_list <- sapply(plate_file_names, fread, simplify = F, USE.NAMES = T)

all_plates <- rbindlist(plates_list, idcol = "plate") %>%  #figured it out... the order of plates is not 1,2,3 but 1,10 etc
    dplyr::select(-c("Number of Analyzed Fields", "Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Min per Well" )) #bc spot area min is all 1, scaling and centreing it makes NaN values

p1_3 <- left_join(all_plates[all_plates$plate %in% c("P1_SIMA_V5.txt", "P2_SIMA_V5.txt", "P3_SIMA_V5.txt")], quad_gene_key[,c(1,2)], by = c("WellName" = "Well")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename("Gene" = "Original")
p4_6 <- left_join(all_plates[all_plates$plate %in% c("P4_SIMA_V5.txt","P5_SIMA_V5.txt","P6_SIMA_V5.txt")], quad_gene_key[,c(1,3)], by = c("WellName" = "Well")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename("Gene" = "Stamp1")
p7_9 <- left_join(all_plates[all_plates$plate %in% c("P7_SIMA_V5.txt","P8_SIMA_V5.txt","P9_SIMA_V5.txt")], quad_gene_key[,c(1,4)], by = c("WellName" = "Well")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename("Gene" = "Stamp2")
p10_12 <- left_join(all_plates[all_plates$plate %in% c("P10_SIMA_V5.txt","P11_SIMA_V5.txt","P12_SIMA_V5.txt")], quad_gene_key[,c(1,5)], by = c("WellName" = "Well")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename("Gene" = "Stamp3")

final_plate_list <- bind_rows(p1_3, p4_6, p7_9, p10_12)


# 
# df <- spot_area_df_extended <- data.frame(spot_area = final_plate_list$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Mean per Well`,
#                             knockdown = final_plate_list$Gene, plate = final_plate_list$plate, row = final_plate_list$Row, col = final_plate_list$Col) %>%
#     dplyr::filter(knockdown != "Empty")  # <-- change if needed

df <- spot_area_df_extended <- data.frame(spot_area = final_plate_list$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well`,
                            knockdown = final_plate_list$Gene, plate = final_plate_list$plate, row = final_plate_list$Row, col = final_plate_list$Col) %>%
    dplyr::filter(knockdown != "Empty")  # <-- change if needed



# df <- spot_area_df_extended <- data.frame(spot_area = all_plate_z_scores$`Spots - Spot Area [px²] - Median per Well_z_score`,
#                             knockdown = all_plate_z_scores$Gene, plate = all_plate_z_scores$plate, row = all_plate_z_scores$Row, col = all_plate_z_scores$Col) %>%
#     dplyr::filter(knockdown != "Empty")  # <-- change if needed


y  <- "spot_area"
control_level <- "AAVS1"

# Ensure types
df$knockdown <- relevel(factor(df$knockdown), ref = control_level)
df$plate <- factor(df$plate)


# Quadrant blocks

# Make sure plate is character
df$plate <- as.character(df$plate)

# Extract numeric plate index from "P1_SIMA_V5.txt", "P10_SIMA_V5.txt", etc.
plate_num <- as.integer(sub("^P([0-9]+)_.*$", "\\1", df$plate))

# Create layout blocks of 3 plates: (P1-P3)->1, (P4-P6)->2, ...
df$layout_block <- factor((plate_num - 1) %/% 3 + 1)


if (!("layout_block" %in% names(df))) df$layout_block <- factor(df$layout_block)

# If row and col are currently numeric-like strings:
df$row_num <- as.numeric(as.character(df$row))
df$col_num <- as.numeric(as.character(df$col))

# then optionally scale for stability:
df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$row_num))
df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(df$col_num))

# (If you already have scaled columns, adjust names accordingly.)
if (!("row_sc" %in% names(df))) df$row_sc <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(df$row_num)))
if (!("col_sc" %in% names(df))) df$col_sc <- as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(df$col_num)))



set.seed(123)


df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    log_spot_area = log(spot_area),
    row_f = factor(row_num),
    col_f = factor(col_num)
  )

# m_final <- glmmTMB(
#   log_spot_area ~ knockdown + plate + row_f + col_f,
#   family = t_family(link = "identity"),
#   data = df
# )

# so that emmeans knows that its a log transformed model
m_final <- glmmTMB(
  log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate + row_f + col_f,
  family = t_family(link = "identity"),
  data = df
)



# Simulated residuals
sim_final <- simulateResiduals(m_final, n = 2000)

# ------------------------------
# 1) Global DHARMa diagnostics
# ------------------------------
plot(sim_final)

cat("\n--- DHARMa tests ---\n")
print(testUniformity(sim_final))
# save as pdf 7x5 inches QQplot_residuals_glmtbb

print(testDispersion(sim_final))
print(testOutliers(sim_final))

# Optional omnibus test
cat("\n--- Combined DHARMa test ---\n")
print(testResiduals(sim_final))

# ------------------------------
# 2) Residuals vs fitted values
# ------------------------------
plotResiduals(sim_final, fitted(m_final),
              main = "DHARMa residuals vs fitted values")

# ------------------------------
# 3) Residuals vs main predictors
# ------------------------------
plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df$row_num,
              main = "DHARMa residuals vs row number")

plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df$col_num,
              main = "DHARMa residuals vs column number")

plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df$row_f,
              main = "DHARMa residuals vs row factor")

plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df$col_f,
              main = "DHARMa residuals vs column factor")

plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df$plate,
              main = "DHARMa residuals vs plate")

# This can be busy if many genes, but still useful if you want to check
# whether particular knockdowns are systematically misfit
# plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df_model$knockdown,
#               main = "DHARMa residuals vs knockdown")

# ------------------------------
# 4) Formal categorical tests
# ------------------------------
cat("\n--- Categorical residual tests ---\n")
print(testCategorical(sim_final, catPred = df$row_f))
print(testCategorical(sim_final, catPred = df$col_f))
print(testCategorical(sim_final, catPred = df$plate))
#print(testCategorical(sim_final, catPred = df$knockdown))

# ------------------------------
# 5) Create residual diagnostic data frame
# ------------------------------
diag_df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    fitted_log = predict(m_final, type = "response"),
    fitted_raw = exp(fitted_log),
    dharma_resid = sim_final$scaledResiduals
  )

# ------------------------------
# 6) Spatial heatmap: average residual by well position
#    Very useful for plate-based screens
# ------------------------------
p_heatmap <- diag_df %>%
  group_by(row_num, col_num) %>%
  summarise(mean_resid = mean(dharma_resid), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = col_num, y = row_num, fill = mean_resid)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Mean\nDHARMa residual"
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(
    title = "Average DHARMa residual by plate position",
    x = "Column",
    y = "Row"
  )

print(p_heatmap)

# ------------------------------
# 7) Per-plate heatmaps
#    Good for checking whether one or two plates are still problematic
# ------------------------------
p_heatmap_plate <- diag_df %>%
  group_by(plate, row_num, col_num) %>%
  summarise(mean_resid = mean(dharma_resid), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = col_num, y = row_num, fill = mean_resid)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0.5, limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Mean\nDHARMa residual"
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ plate) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  labs(
    title = "DHARMa residual heatmap by plate",
    x = "Column",
    y = "Row"
  )

print(p_heatmap_plate)

# ------------------------------
# 8) Residual distributions by row / col / plate
# ------------------------------
p_row_box <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = row_f, y = dharma_resid)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "DHARMa residuals by row", x = "Row", y = "Scaled residual")

p_col_box <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = col_f, y = dharma_resid)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "DHARMa residuals by column", x = "Column", y = "Scaled residual")

p_plate_box <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = plate, y = dharma_resid)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "DHARMa residuals by plate", x = "Plate", y = "Scaled residual")

print(p_row_box)
print(p_col_box)
print(p_plate_box)

# ------------------------------
# 9) Extreme residual wells
#    Helpful for finding segmentation / QC issues
# ------------------------------
extreme_wells <- diag_df %>%
  filter(dharma_resid < 0.01 | dharma_resid > 0.99) %>%
  arrange(dharma_resid)

cat("\n--- Number of extreme wells ---\n")
print(nrow(extreme_wells))

cat("\n--- Top extreme wells ---\n")
print(
  extreme_wells %>%
    select(plate, row_num, col_num, knockdown, spot_area, fitted_raw, dharma_resid) %>%
    head(30)
)

cat("\n--- Extreme wells by plate ---\n")
print(extreme_wells %>% dplyr::count(plate, sort = TRUE))

cat("\n--- Extreme wells by row/col ---\n")
print(extreme_wells %>% dplyr::count(row_num, col_num, sort = TRUE) %>% head(20))

# ------------------------------
# 10) Observed vs fitted
# ------------------------------
p_obs_fit_log <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = fitted_log, y = log_spot_area)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs fitted on log scale",
    x = "Fitted log spot area",
    y = "Observed log spot area"
  )

p_obs_fit_raw <- ggplot(diag_df, aes(x = fitted_raw, y = spot_area)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs fitted on raw scale",
    x = "Fitted spot area",
    y = "Observed spot area"
  )

print(p_obs_fit_log)
print(p_obs_fit_raw)

# ------------------------------
# 11) Save key plots
# ------------------------------
# ggsave("DHARMa_global_plot.png", plot = recordPlot(), width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
# ggsave("DHARMa_heatmap_overall.png", p_heatmap, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
# ggsave("DHARMa_heatmap_by_plate.png", p_heatmap_plate, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
# ggsave("DHARMa_boxplot_row.png", p_row_box, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r itworks}
# ==========================================
# Dunnett contrasts + CI plot + volcano plot
# for final model:
# m_final <- glmmTMB(
#   log_spot_area ~ knockdown + plate + row_f + col_f,
#   family = t_family(link = "identity"),
#   data = df
# )
# ==========================================


# Omnibus tests of the fixed effects in the final model
# install.packages("car")  # If needed

anova_tbl <- car::Anova(
  m_final,
  type = "II",
  component = "cond"
)

print(anova_tbl)

# Display just the overall knockdown test
anova_tbl["knockdown", , drop = FALSE]


control_level <- "AAVS1"

# Build a smaller reference grid by treating plate/row/col as nuisance factors
# If you want averaging to reflect observed frequencies, change wt.nuis to "proportional"
rg <- ref_grid(
  m_final, #m_final
  nuisance = c("plate", "row_f", "col_f"),
  wt.nuis = "equal" #"equal"
)

# Estimated marginal means for knockdown, averaged over nuisance factors
emm <- emmeans(rg, ~ knockdown, type = 'response')

#emm <- emmeans(m_final, 'knockdown', type = 'response')

# Dunnett contrasts vs control
ref_idx <- which(levels(df$knockdown) == control_level)

contr <- contrast(
  emm,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = ref_idx,
  adjust = "dunnett"
)

dunnett_tbl <- summary(contr, infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Standardise CI column names
ci_low_name  <- intersect(c("lower.CL", "asymp.LCL"), names(dunnett_tbl))[1]
ci_high_name <- intersect(c("upper.CL", "asymp.UCL"), names(dunnett_tbl))[1]

if (is.na(ci_low_name) || is.na(ci_high_name)) {
  stop("Could not find confidence interval columns in the emmeans output.")
}

names(dunnett_tbl)[names(dunnett_tbl) == "estimate"] <- "diff_log"
names(dunnett_tbl)[names(dunnett_tbl) == ci_low_name] <- "lwr"
names(dunnett_tbl)[names(dunnett_tbl) == ci_high_name] <- "upr"
names(dunnett_tbl)[names(dunnett_tbl) == "p.value"] <- "padj"

# Add fold-change and plotting columns
dunnett_tbl <- dunnett_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    contrast = as.character(contrast),
    gene = str_trim(sub(paste0("\\s*-\\s*", control_level, "$"), "", contrast)),
    fold_change = exp(diff_log),
    lwr_fc = exp(lwr),
    upr_fc = exp(upr),
    log2FC = diff_log / log(2),
    neglog10_p = -log10(pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
    sig = padj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & log2FC > 0 ~ "Increase",
      sig & log2FC < 0 ~ "Decrease",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

# Save results
#write.csv(dunnett_tbl, "dunnett_AAVS1_vs_all_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(head(dunnett_tbl))

# -------------------------
# Confidence interval plot
# -------------------------
ci_tbl <- dunnett_tbl %>%
  arrange(fold_change) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = gene))

p_ci <- ggplot(ci_tbl, aes(y = gene, x = fold_change, colour = direction)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = lwr_fc, xend = upr_fc, y = gene, yend = gene),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "grey35"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Increase" = "#D55E00",
      "Decrease" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Fold-change vs ", control_level),
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL,
    title = paste0("Dunnett contrasts: ", control_level, " vs all knockdowns"),
    subtitle = "Points are estimated fold-changes; horizontal lines are 95% confidence intervals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_ci)

# -------------------------
# Volcano plot
# -------------------------
label_df <- dunnett_tbl %>%
  filter(sig) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

p_volcano <- ggplot(dunnett_tbl, aes(x = log2FC, y = neglog10_p, colour = direction)) +
```

```{r modelcompare}

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Use exactly the same observations for every model
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df_compare <- df %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(spot_area),
    spot_area > 0,
    !is.na(knockdown),
    !is.na(plate),
    is.finite(row_num),
    is.finite(col_num)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    knockdown = factor(knockdown),
    plate = factor(plate),
    row_f = factor(row_num),
    col_f = factor(col_num)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

df_compare$knockdown <- relevel(
  df_compare$knockdown,
  ref = "AAVS1"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Five candidate models
# ---------------------------------------------------------
models <- list(
  M1_lm_basic = lm(
    log(spot_area) ~ knockdown,
    data = df_compare,
    na.action = na.fail
  ),

  M2_lm_plate = lm(
    log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate,
    data = df_compare,
    na.action = na.fail
  ),

  M3_lm_quadratic_position = lm(
    log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate +
      poly(row_num, 2, raw = TRUE) +
      poly(col_num, 2, raw = TRUE),
    data = df_compare,
    na.action = na.fail
  ),

  M4_lm_rowcol_factors = lm(
    log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate + row_f + col_f,
    data = df_compare,
    na.action = na.fail
  ),

  M5_t_final = glmmTMB(
    log(spot_area) ~ knockdown + plate + row_f + col_f,
    family = t_family(link = "identity"),
    REML = FALSE,
    data = df_compare,
    na.action = na.fail
  )
)

stopifnot(all(vapply(models, nobs, numeric(1)) == nrow(df_compare)))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Convergence and DHARMa diagnostics
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fit_ok <- function(model) {
  if (inherits(model, "glmmTMB")) {
    return(
      isTRUE(model$fit$convergence == 0) &&
        isTRUE(model$sdr$pdHess)
    )
  }

  # Flag rank-deficient LM fits for investigation
  !anyNA(coef(model))
}

# A failed diagnostic is recorded as NA, with a message.
safe_p <- function(test) {
  tryCatch(
    as.numeric(test()$p.value),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Diagnostic failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NA_real_
    }
  )
}

diagnostics <- lapply(models, function(model) {
  if (!fit_ok(model)) return(NULL)

  tryCatch(
    simulateResiduals(
      fittedModel = model,
      n = 2000,
      refit = FALSE,
      plot = FALSE,
      seed = 123
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("DHARMa simulation failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
})

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Comparison table
# ---------------------------------------------------------
comparison <- bind_rows(lapply(names(models), function(nm) {
  fit <- models[[nm]]
  sim <- diagnostics[[nm]]
  ll <- logLik(fit)

  tibble(
    model = nm,
    fit_ok = fit_ok(fit),
    n = nobs(fit),
    parameters = as.numeric(attr(ll, "df")),
    AIC = as.numeric(AIC(fit)),
    BIC = as.numeric(BIC(fit)),
    uniformity_p = if (is.null(sim)) NA_real_ else
      safe_p(function() testUniformity(sim, plot = FALSE)),
    dispersion_p = if (is.null(sim)) NA_real_ else
      safe_p(function() testDispersion(sim, plot = FALSE)),
    outliers_p = if (is.null(sim)) NA_real_ else
      safe_p(function() testOutliers(
        sim,
        type = "binomial",
        plot = FALSE
      ))
  )
}))

# Calculate delta AIC only among valid fits with finite AIC.
eligible <- with(comparison, fit_ok & is.finite(AIC))

comparison$delta_AIC <- NA_real_
if (any(eligible)) {
  comparison$delta_AIC[eligible] <-
    comparison$AIC[eligible] - min(comparison$AIC[eligible])
}

# Keep the progression from simplest to final model.
comparison_table <- comparison %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(AIC, BIC, delta_AIC), ~ round(.x, 2)),
    across(ends_with("_p"), ~ signif(.x, 3))
  ) %>%
  print(width = Inf)

#save

write_csv(comparison_table, "dharma_comparisons_models.csv")

# Retain your final model for emmeans, etc.
m_final <- models$M5_t_final



# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Inspect final-model residual plots
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sim_final <- diagnostics$M5_t_final

if (!is.null(sim_final)) {
  plot(sim_final)

  plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df_compare$row_f)
  plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df_compare$col_f)
  plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df_compare$plate)
  plotResiduals(sim_final, form = df_compare$knockdown)
}

print(testUniformity(sim_final))
# save as pdf 7x5 inches QQplot_residuals_glmtbb

print(testDispersion(sim_final))
print(testOutliers(sim_final))
```
